description: Pixel family that samples material coverage, optionally applies volume dithering, discards uncovered fragments, and writes SV_DEPTH for a shadow map.

hashFastPaths.evidence: Verified sampled material-coverage ShadowDepth writer variant.

checks.meaning: The input signature receives the caster's ShadowDepth interpolant.
The output signature declares a hardware depth result.
One Texture2D supplies sampled material or opacity coverage.
The coverage texture uses one default sampler.
Material coverage is sampled before the shadow-depth write.
Uncovered fragments are rejected from the shadow map.
The color target is incidental and remains zero.
The interpolated caster depth is scaled, biased, saturated, and written to SV_DEPTH.

runtimeContract.controlSafety: Preserve coverage discard and depth bias. This family casts shadow-map depth; it does not evaluate receiver lighting.
